method: Binary search over distinct known edge DSM minima, using directed breadth-first reachability independently of A*. Verify both adjacent IEEE-754 water values through the production strict minimumDsm < water + lowering - 0.30 predicate and A*.
units: Water and DSM elevations are metres EGM2008; water level is not water depth or a river-gauge reading.

model.unknownCoverage: Excluded in both cases, separately from modeled depth closures.

threshold.precisionNote: Full precision reproduces this sampled-DSM graph and arithmetic; it does not imply surveyed elevation accuracy or an observed flood threshold. Critical edges form a separating cut, not proof of a single physical choke point.

suggestedComparison.wording: At the same 11.6 m assumed water surface, 0.390 m of uniform DSM lowering changes the selected network result from a 27.876 km path to no path.

attribution.surface: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM; see data/NOTICE.txt and data/licenses/copernicus-dem-licenses.pdf.
attribution.licenseNote: This deterministic derived research result retains source attribution; original data identities are unchanged.

limitations: Network-only path to the selected OSM hospital anchor. Road passability, vehicle access, hospital entrance, capacity and operation are unverified. Scenario depths use a uniform EGM2008 water surface over a lowered DSM, without hydraulics, drainage, bridges or barriers. A no-path result does not establish isolation from all hospitals.
